full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-watercolor character illustration shows a weathered older man seated and studying a small tool in his gloved hands, against a nearly blank cream-paper background. Faint page wear and pale sketch marks remain visible around the figure rather than forming a full setting. At the upper center, unruly gray hair rises behind a pair of round copper-colored goggles resting on his forehead. His lowered eyes, furrowed brow, stubbled jaw, and close wrinkles give the face a concentrated, tired expression. A broad off-white coat surrounds his torso and knees, with padded seams, a raised collar, small round fittings, and a circular insignia-like detail on the upper sleeve. Dark cables and compact mechanical parts cluster near his chest and at the back of the seat, interrupting the large pale cloth shapes. The hands meet just left of center around the thin implement, their knuckles and gloves drawn with tiny crossings of brown line. The lower frame is filled by the bent knees and soft folds of the heavy garment; the figure's feet and the seat's full structure remain outside the crop. Fine, restless pen lines define hair, seams, hardware, and facial creases, while thin washes of ocher, warm gray, and muted blue supply volume without obscuring the paper. Soft light from the upper left brightens the coat and forehead, with small darker pockets inside folds and mechanisms. The overall composition holds intricate mechanical detail inside a quiet seated silhouette, making the close act of inspection feel thoughtful and lived-in.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形钢笔与水彩人物插图描绘一名饱经风霜的年长男子坐着端详手套中一件小工具，背景是近乎空白的奶油色纸面。人物周围保留了淡淡页痕和浅色草稿线，而未构成完整场景。上方中央，蓬乱灰发从一副搁在额头上的铜色圆护目镜后翘起。他下垂的目光、紧皱的眉、带胡茬的下颌和细密皱纹，让面容显得专注而疲惫。宽大的灰白外衣裹住躯干和双膝，带有加厚接缝、高领、小圆配件和上臂处类似圆徽的细节。深色管线和紧凑机械件聚在胸前及座位后方，打断大块浅色布面。双手在中央偏左握拢细长器具，指节和手套由细小交错的棕线绘成。画面下方由弯曲双膝和厚衣的柔软褶皱填满；脚和座位的完整结构都在裁切之外。细密躁动的钢笔线条刻画头发、衣缝、金属件和面部皱纹，赭色、暖灰与柔蓝的薄色洗则提供体积，却不盖住纸面。来自左上方的柔光照亮外衣和额头，褶皱与机件内部留有小片较深的暗部。整体构图把繁复机械细节收在安静的坐姿剪影中，使近距离端详的动作显得深思而富有生活痕迹。
style_prompt_en: The image has an intricate pen-and-watercolor illustration finish on aged cream paper. Fine brown contour and crosshatching lines carry most of the structure, with transparent ocher, warm gray, muted blue, and copper washes settling into selected planes. Large pale shapes leave breathing room for tight clusters of tiny circular and linear detail. Outer edges may remain sketched and incomplete, while focal surfaces are built through repeated, precise marks. Soft diffuse light keeps the paper bright and lets line density, rather than heavy paint, form the main shadows. Slight stain, dry grain, and irregular pigment edges give the surface a handled, tactile quality. Rounded volumes and angular fittings alternate in a compact rhythm, and the overall effect is inventive, weathered, and carefully observed.
style_prompt_zh: 图像呈现陈旧奶油色纸上的繁复钢笔与水彩插图质感。细棕色轮廓线和交叉排线承担主要结构，透明的赭色、暖灰、柔蓝及铜色水洗停留在选定平面上。大块浅色形状为成簇的细小圆形和线性细节留下呼吸空间。外边缘可以保持草绘般不完整，焦点表面则由重复而精确的笔画建立。柔和漫射光保持纸面明亮，让线条密度而非厚重颜料形成主要阴影。轻微污痕、干燥颗粒与不规则色边使表面有被翻阅过的触感。圆润体积和棱角分明的配件交替成紧凑节奏，整体效果富有创造性、风化感和细致观察力。
theme_en: A weathered technician studying a small tool
theme_zh: 端详小工具的沧桑技师
name: Katsuya Terada
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
